answer: A tide-locked escrow ladder makes sybil entry slow. A newcomer locks a $180 bond and works three tides of 10 real client jobs over 30 days, each drawn from the shared oasis of verified requests. After each tide, established peers audit three jobs as the spiral tightens: the audit circle grows by one peer each tide, starting at two. Miss a tide or fail an audit and $60 burns, freezing the next tide. Three clean tides return the bond and unlock paid work. Forging 1,000 identities needs $180,000 plus 30,000 real jobs, about 7,500 hours. Like a tide gate letting one boat through at a time.
